title: Great tour!
text: Jose Carlos was super. He was friendly, knowledgeable & very accommodating - switching out one stop the itinerary on the fly because we’d been there already. He knows the city, its history and shared fun recommendations with us for the rest of our stay in Barcelona!

title: Perfect way to explore the city
text: The perfect way to explore Barcelona! Our guide Isaac, was full of great stories and was a fun and engaging guide. Barcelona streets are chaotic but Isaac led us through. Pedaling regular bikes was easy for our group ranging from 12 to 50 years old. Highly recommended!
author: Alexander_D

title: Barcelona on a Bike--Exhilarating
text:
First time on an E-bike for all 9 of us!  

A little difficult in the small tight streets and cross walks but on the bike lanes it was quick, easy and quite an experience.  

The tour was well structured, and Alfredo, our guide did a good job trying to keep us together. We had 4 seniors, a middle-aged couple and 3 teenagers. 

The Familia Sagrada was amazing. 

Loved Barcelona.
